description: This file defines an interface for AWS STS regional endpoint configuration options, specifying methods to get the endpoint type and configuration array.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: An interface that provides access methods for STS regional endpoints configuration options, including retrieving the endpoint type and configuration as an array.

methods.name: getEndpointsType
methods.description: Returns the type of endpoints (e.g., regional or global).

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
